Body.Content:
This feature introduces policy strictness control, enabling organizations to define how rigorously each governance policy evaluates and flags potential violations in outgoing emails. Governance policies serve as real-time guardrails, ensuring communications adhere to business, legal, and compliance standards before they are sent to customers.

With this enhancement, supervisors can configure the strictness level for each policy. Lower strictness settings apply more lenient enforcement, reducing false positives and allowing borderline scenarios to pass, while higher settings perform more rigorous checks to identify subtle or potentially risky violations. This flexibility allows organizations to align policy enforcement with their compliance requirements and risk tolerance.

All policies are set to medium strictness by default, providing a balanced level of enforcement. Organizations can then adjust strictness levels per policy depending on the nature of the rule. For example, highly sensitive policies, such as those related to data protection or regulatory compliance, can be configured with stricter enforcement, while policies focused on tone or content guidance can be set to be more lenient to avoid unnecessary disruptions.

At runtime, the governance policies use the configured strictness level to determine how policy violations are flagged when outgoing emails are evaluated. This ensures that enforcement is consistent and adaptable across different policy types and business scenarios.

By enabling strictness control at the policy level, organizations can fine-tune governance enforcement without modifying the underlying policy definitions, helping balance compliance protection, agent productivity, and a seamless customer communication experience.

Business Value:

Take control of how your governance policies handle outbound email violations. With adjustable strictness levels, you can cut down on false positives when flexibility matters or apply tighter controls for sensitive situations. This balance helps you build confidence in AI-driven enforcement while keeping your policies aligned with your risk tolerance, compliance requirements, and business goals.

Enabled for:

Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

GA date: July CY2026
